en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/976@1/des: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/977@2/des: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/978@3/des: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/979@4/des: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/980@5/des: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/981@6/des: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/982@7/des: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/983@8/des: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/984@9/des: The Supreme Court has consistently stood in the way of progress by implementing an overly narrow interpretation of the Constitution. I support drastic measures to reduce its influence.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/985@10/de: There have been some terrible decisions made by the Court. We might consider some measures to make the court more accountable to the popular will.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/986@11/de: This is an unfounded rumor that the McKinley campaign has disseminated to discredit my candidacy.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/987@12/de: 8 years of a William Jennings Bryan presidency will leave the Court in much better shape to address our nation's problems.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/989@13/de: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/990@14/de: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/991@15/de: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/992@16/de: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/993@17/de: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/994@18/de: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/999@19/de: The humblest citizen in all the land, when clad in the armor of a righteous cause, is stronger than all the hosts of error.

en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/1012@26/d: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.

en.1896_Bryan_Sewall/answers_json/1014@28/d: Let's hit on the issue of tariffs. These voters need to be reminded that tariffs increase the cost of farm equipment and other manufactured goods.
